class ProprietaryScanner:
    def __init__(self, config_file: str = None):
        self.config = self._load_config(config_file)
        self.proprietary_keywords = self.config.get('proprietary_keywords', [])
        self.known_proprietary_packages = self.config.get('known_proprietary_packages', {})
        self.proprietary_companies = self.config.get('proprietary_companies', [])
        self.exclude_directories = self.config.get('exclude_directories', [])
    
    def _load_config(self, config_file: str = None) -> Dict:
        """Load configuration from file or use defaults."""
        default_config = {
            "scan_directories": ["/usr/bin", "/usr/local/bin", "/opt", "/home"],
            "exclude_directories": ["/proc", "/sys", "/dev", "/tmp"],
            "proprietary_keywords": [
                "proprietary", "commercial", "closed-source", "license",
                "trial", "demo", "shareware", "freemium"
            ],
            "proprietary_companies": [
                "microsoft", "google", "adobe", "oracle", "apple", "amazon",
                "facebook", "meta", "nvidia", "amd", "intel", "vmware",
                "autodesk", "mathworks", "wolfram", "spotify", "slack",
                "dropbox", "teamviewer", "zoom", "skype", "discord"
            ],
            "known_proprietary_packages": {
                "google-chrome-stable": "proprietary",
                "slack-desktop": "proprietary",
                "teamviewer": "proprietary",
                "zoom": "proprietary",
                "skypeforlinux": "proprietary",
                "spotify-client": "proprietary",
                "discord": "proprietary",
                "steam": "proprietary",
                "microsoft-edge-stable": "proprietary",
                "vscode": "proprietary",
                "intellij-idea": "proprietary",
                "pycharm": "proprietary",
                "webstorm": "proprietary",
                "datagrip": "proprietary",
                "goland": "proprietary",
                "clion": "proprietary",
                "rubymine": "proprietary",
                "phpstorm": "proprietary",
                "matlab": "proprietary",
                "mathematica": "proprietary",
                "adobe-reader": "proprietary",
                "adobe-flashplugin": "proprietary",
                "dropbox": "proprietary",
                "virtualbox": "proprietary",
                "vmware-workstation": "proprietary",
                "nvidia-driver": "proprietary",
                "amd-driver": "proprietary",
                "cuda": "proprietary",
                "rocm": "proprietary"
            },
            "output_format": "table",
            "verbose": False
        }
        
        if config_file and os.path.exists(config_file):
            try:
                with open(config_file, 'r') as f:
                    user_config = json.load(f)
                    default_config.update(user_config)
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, IOError) as e:
                print(f"Warning: Could not load config file {config_file}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        
        return default_config
